business_summary: Trailhead Global Holdings,Inc. operates restaurant business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Food and beverage business, Real estate leasing business, and Management outsourcing business segments. It develops, manages, and franchises Chikuho Ramen Yamagoya, Basaraka, and Ikkoryu through directly managed stores; and engages in the real estate lease business, as well as operates hot bath facilities. The company was formerly known as Y.S.Food Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Trailhead Global Holdings,Inc. in January 2026. Trailhead Global Holdings,Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
